coldStart.note: From launch to an editable page, including Playwright's connection. The stage 6 build measured beside it the same day has a median of about 500 ms (428 ms in an earlier run), so the rise is the machine's, not the app's

keystroke50.note: Transaction, editor update and browser layout for one character; 47 pages

repaginate50.note: Measuring every block and redrawing the sheet breaks, 50 pages, alternating new lines and characters

save50.wait: Save to disk after the debounce

open100.wait: Open a 100-page document from the library
open100.note: Read, parse, draw and lay out all 94 pages

pdf50.note: Print layout in a hidden window and the PDF written

versionCommit50.note: git add and commit of a changed 50-page document, from the renderer's request to its answer

history500.note: From a click on the save state to all 500+ rows drawn: Git log, tags, grouping and rendering

review50.note: Finding every suggestion and comment in a 50-page document with 100 changes

keystrokeSync50.note: Keystroke to glyph in a 50-page document during 4 syncs to a local fake GitHub (1607 ms each), each pushing a new version

docx50.note: From the renderer's request to the .docx written

open100Images.note: Read, parse, draw and lay out all 104 pages with 20 images of about 2 MB stored beside the document; images fade in

insertImage20.note: From paste to the picture decoded on the page: reading the file, hashing and writing it beside the document, and drawing it
